title: Why have pressure ulcers risen on Ward 12? (example)
effect: Pressure ulcer rate on Ward 12 has risen since month 18

children.text: Staff not trained on the settings

causes.text: Skin bundle not restarted after outbreak
Two tissue viability link nurses left
More bed moves to make space

sample.look: The new mattresses, used without training, are the most likely cause. Test a short training and settings checklist with a PDSA cycle, and keep the Ward 12 U chart running to see the effect.
